adaptation.exercise: L1 — Bodyweight abs and loading review
adaptation.previous: November 1: BW×15/15 at RIR 3/3. Follow-up reports minor strain at the original ab site during the first few reps, then gone.
adaptation.decision: Defer the 5 lb trial. Bodyweight work only if comfortable; stop or reduce it if original-site pain/pulling returns.
adaptation.reason: The pain-free loading prerequisite is not met. A sensation fading after several reps does not establish readiness for added weight. Reconsider loading after comfortable BW work during/after and the next morning, with a fresh review.
